title: The Last Light at Bellweather
tagline: A dark lantern, a missing logbook, and a tide that keeps its own time.
setting: An isolated tidal lighthouse and its signal house
intro: The causeway will be underwater by morning. At Bellweather, the porch bell falls silent, a logbook disappears, and the lighthouse goes dark. Keeper Maren Vale is found dead. Six timed records lead from the first missing object to the final inventory. Reconstruct the evening before the tide erases the way back.

chapters.name: Before the fog bell
chapters.brief: The porch bell has fallen silent. Compare the first accounts of the evening.
chapters.revelation: Rosa Hart is the only person who makes exactly four of these five accounts true. She took the brass clapper before the squall.

chapters.name: Accounts before the squall
chapters.brief: 19:20 · Count four account cards about the missing black logbook.
chapters.revelation: Iris Bell is the only candidate who makes exactly two of the four accounts true, placing her with the logbook's removal before the blackout.

chapters.name: The logbook trail
chapters.brief: 19:30 · Match stations and evidence in the pre-squall inventory.
chapters.revelation: The completed grid pairs Iris Bell with the black logbook at 19:30.

chapters.name: The dark lantern
chapters.brief: 19:40 · Reconstruct the blackout and the last positions in the lantern room.
chapters.revelation: Theo Finch is the only suspect sharing Maren's lantern-room space at the blackout; the floor plan establishes opportunity.

chapters.name: The moved lens key
chapters.brief: 20:10 · Count the accounts about movement of the brass lens key.
chapters.revelation: Theo Finch is the only candidate that makes exactly two of the five accounts true in the 20:10 movement record.

chapters.name: The later inventory
chapters.brief: 20:30 · Match the later inventory after the key has changed hands.
chapters.revelation: At 20:30, Elias Quill carries the brass lens key. This later inventory does not change the earlier account that Theo removed it.

ending: The fog bell and the logbook explain two earlier disappearances: Rosa took the clapper, and Iris removed the logbook. The fatal floor plan tells a different story. Theo was the only suspect alone with Maren when the lantern went dark. He also removed the lens key, which Elias carried by the final inventory. With each event in its proper place, the Bellweather file can finally close.

title: The Briar House papers
tagline: A stolen key. A silent house. Four pieces of evidence.
setting: An old country house, after dark
intro: An envelope arrives with no return address. Inside: a floor plan, four witness accounts, a torn photograph and a note from Briar House. These four records are standalone deductions; open them in any order and keep each solved piece in the case file.

chapters.name: Conflicting accounts
chapters.brief: Start with the statements. Only the specified number can be true.

chapters.name: The duplicate key
chapters.brief: Match people, rooms and objects to identify the key’s carrier.

chapters.name: The torn photograph
chapters.brief: Rebuild the shape left in the photograph.

chapters.name: The last room
chapters.brief: Place everyone on the floor plan, then name the murderer.

ending: The four Briar House records are filed: statements, possessions, a photograph and the final scene. Each remains available whenever you want another look.

title: The midnight departure
tagline: A stopped clock. A lost signal. Nobody leaves yet.
setting: An overnight train on the coast
intro: A coastal night-train file contains four records from the carriage and its signal box. Restore the signal, trace a route, compare the statements, then reconstruct the carriage. Each record is a standalone deduction; open them in any order.

chapters.name: A signal in the static
chapters.brief: Turn each tile until the whole network connects.

chapters.name: The conductor’s route
chapters.brief: Follow the numbers through every square.

chapters.name: The clockless room
chapters.brief: Test the witnesses’ accounts against the truth count.

chapters.name: A quiet carriage
chapters.brief: Rebuild the scene before the train departs.

ending: The four records are filed: signal, route, accounts and carriage. Each remains available whenever you want to revisit the midnight departure file.

title: Secrets under glass
tagline: Follow the water. Turn on the lights. Find the truth.
intro: The conservatory caretaker has left four records among the glass and winter plants. Water levels, a lighting plan, an inventory and a floor plan each offer a standalone deduction. Open any record in any order; your solved evidence stays in the file.

chapters.brief: Fill the glass tanks to match the edge clues.

title: The unfinished invitation
tagline: A tide-mark, a sealed claim, and a gathering nobody will own.
setting: Pike & Tide, a coastal print shop before the harbour audit
intro: An unsigned invitation brings former Pike & Tide staff back to the coast. Its tide-mark belongs to Iona Reed, an apprentice who left after the 2022 shop fire. One sealed envelope still sits in the drying room, addressed to Iona and never posted. Follow eight timed records to learn who arranged the gathering, why the old claim was hidden, and which facts are only opportunity.

chapters.name: The plate under the press
chapters.brief: 07:50 · Compare the accounts of who retrieved Iona's copper tide-mark plate.
chapters.revelation: Mara Voss is the only candidate who makes exactly three of the four accounts true. She retrieved Iona's copper plate before the new invitation run.

chapters.name: The fresh stock
chapters.brief: 08:05 · Match paper stock to batch marks and find the packet's courier.
chapters.revelation: Elias Bell carries batch 12, the mark stamped on the fresh invitation packet. The stock is new, even though its tide-mark is Iona's.

chapters.name: The tide-mark proof
chapters.brief: 08:15 · Rebuild the five-by-five mark from the smudged proof sheet.
chapters.revelation: The rebuilt mark is Iona Reed's distinctive tide symbol. It links the fresh invitations to her old copper plate without proving who commissioned the new run.

chapters.name: The drying-room access
chapters.brief: 08:40 · Reconstruct the positions around Celia's missing archive packet.
chapters.revelation: Elias Bell is the only suspect sharing Celia Wren's room in the reconstruction. The floor plan establishes opportunity around the missing packet, not authorship or guilt.

chapters.name: The sealed envelope
chapters.brief: 08:55 · Count the accounts about the sealed envelope's route to the post room.
chapters.revelation: Elias Bell is the only candidate who makes exactly two accounts true. He carried the envelope toward the post room; the route still does not identify the gathering's organizer.

chapters.name: The commission ledger
chapters.brief: 09:10 · Match job numbers to ledger entries and identify the commission card's carrier.
chapters.revelation: Orrin Pike carries the harbour commission card for the invitation run. The ledger connects him to the job that used Iona's mark.

chapters.name: The old seal
chapters.brief: 09:20 · Rebuild the four-wave seal pressed into Iona's unposted claim.
chapters.revelation: The old four-wave seal belongs to the unposted claim Iona left after the 2022 fire. It predates batch 12 and separates her authorship from Orrin's later commission.

chapters.name: Who sent the invitations?
chapters.brief: 09:35 · Use the recovered mark, route and commission before naming the organizer.
chapters.revelation: Orrin Pike is the only candidate who makes exactly three of the four final accounts true. He arranged the gathering to control the old evidence.

ending: In 2022, Iona Reed left a signed authorship claim in the drying room after the shop fire, before she left the coast. On 9 September 2026, Orrin Pike retrieved her copper plate and used its tide-mark on a fresh harbour commission run. He staged the gathering so former staff would repeat his founding story and hand over old samples before the harbour audit could connect the mark to Iona. Elias Bell's route and the floor plan explain access to the envelope; they do not make Elias the organizer. The stock ledger and final accounts identify Orrin, while the sealed claim restores Iona's authorship.
